result.topic_en: Calculations with quantities $z_\kappa$ involving powers of a root of unity $\alpha$ (partial-fraction identities modulo a prime $\lambda$), together with diagrams of point lattices and the derivative of the geometric sum $1+x+\dots+x^{\lambda-1}$.
result.transcription:

$z_\kappa z_\lambda =$
$\frac{1}{\alpha^\kappa-\alpha^\lambda}\left(\frac{\alpha^\kappa}{1-\alpha^\kappa w} - \frac{\alpha^\lambda}{1-\alpha^\lambda w}\right) = \frac{1}{(1-\alpha^\kappa w)(1-\alpha^\lambda w)}$
$\frac{1}{\alpha^{-\kappa}-w} - \frac{1}{\alpha^{-\lambda}-w} = \frac{\alpha^{-\lambda}-\alpha^{-\kappa}}{\alpha^{-\kappa}-w}$

$z_\kappa z_{\kappa'} = \frac{g(1-z(\kappa))\,\alpha^\kappa}{\alpha^\kappa-\alpha^{\kappa'}} z_\kappa - \frac{g(1-z(\kappa'))\,\alpha^{\kappa'}}{\alpha^\kappa-\alpha^{\kappa'}} z_{\kappa'}$
$(\kappa-\kappa')g \equiv 1 \mod \lambda$

[diagrams of point lattices / parallelograms with labelled points]

$\frac{1-x^\lambda}{1-x} = 1+x+\dots+x^{\lambda-1}$
$\frac{1-x^\lambda}{(1-x)^2} + \frac{-\lambda x^{\lambda-1}}{1-x} = 1+\dots+(\lambda-1)x^{\lambda-1}$
$z_1(z_2+\dots+z_\lambda) = z_1(1-\alpha)\lambda$

methods.what: Partial-fraction decomposition of a product of two geometric-type factors $1/((1-\alpha^\kappa w)(1-\alpha^\lambda w))$
Expressing product $z_\kappa z_{\kappa'}$ linearly in $z_\kappa, z_{\kappa'}$ using a modular inverse $g$
Differentiated geometric sum giving $\sum k x^{k}$-type sum
